context: Intake is right when each incoming request is matched to an existing issue or filed as a new one and then placed in an epic or lane, the coordinator does none of the code work itself, requesters get the issue link, scope or priority changes go to the user as one decision at a time, and the user gets a short visual summary. Judge response.md.

checklist.name: Issues first, nothing ad hoc
checklist.description: The share-button request (1) and the Android note list request (2) become tracker issues before any work, and nobody fixes them directly from chat: neither the coordinator nor a fresh ad hoc agent starts code on them. Fixing the share button directly because it is 'a one-liner' scores 0

checklist.name: Placed in an epic or lane
checklist.description: The Android note list issue (2) joins the dark mode epic #171 for the dark lane; the share button issue (1) gets a new epic or a stated home with a lane, or waits for the user's priority call, rather than floating unassigned

checklist.name: Review request routed
checklist.description: The review on #199 is recognized as touching the sync lane's files (`src/sync/`, `android/sync/`): it is routed to or coordinated with the sync lane, or given to a reviewer agent with that conflict noted, not ignored

checklist.name: Duplicate matched, requesters answered
checklist.description: The support report (5) is matched to #101 / #160 rather than filed again, with the answer that the fix ships in 3.4; each requester is told the issue link or outcome

checklist.name: Scope change to the user
checklist.description: Markdown export (4) is not added to epic #172 or the export lane on the coordinator's own call; it goes to the user as a scope or priority decision with options and a recommendation, asked one decision at a time

checklist.name: Short visual summary
checklist.description: The reply to the user shows the five items in a table (item, issue, epic or lane, next step) and leads with what needs the user

checklist.name: Honest
checklist.description: Does not claim any issue, message, or review was created or sent
